note: Quiet, shaded campground on the banks of the Pine River near the Silver Creek Pathway, 5.5 mi N of Luther via State Road; often fills up in summer. Sites 20-26 are walk-in tent sites on a small river peninsula. Undeveloped boat launch off the parking lot for paddlers and anglers (brown and rainbow trout). The Lincoln Hills cycle/ATV trails and ORV routes adjoin the campground. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20 (the note's '~$13-20' dropped), no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day max, 26 sites (19 drive-in, 7 walk-in; all confirmed, derived -> manual). Season changed: derived 'not year-round' -> year-round ('open all year', roads not plowed). Type 'rustic', not equestrian; the page tags 'ORV trails or routes' (Lincoln Hills trails adjacent) but the table says ORV operation between campground and trails 'no', and it is not described as an ORV trail camp. 'Tent and small trailer' is the standard wording (silent on length). Directions carry no road warning.
